topic.title: Organization Projects Page
topic.shortdesc: Organization administrators can use the Projects page to review storage usage for each project in the organization.

body.p: The Projects page in the organization management interface shows how much storage each project uses.

section.title: Projects Disk Usage Table
section.p: The Projects Disk Usage table lists all projects in the organization and their storage usage. The information is updated once per day.
The table contains the following columns:

dlentry.dd: The storage used by the project's Git repository.
The storage used by the project's generated deliverables.
The total storage used by the project (Git repo + deliverables).
The date and time when the usage values were last calculated.

section.note: Storage usage values are updated daily. The table shows the last daily calculation, not real-time usage.
